svg.title: Learning's specificity in the rebuilt model (Kenyon cell-to-MBON synapses undepressed): pairing 3-octanol cuts 4-methylcyclohexanol's spikes by 35% (flies 27%), and pairing 4-methylcyclohexanol cuts 3-octanol's by 14% (flies 38%)
svg.text: On the rebuilt model learning is about as specific as flies' both ways; with 4-methylcyclohexanol paired, still too narrow
Dopamine-gated depression at Kenyon cell-to-MBON11 synapses, its rate set to cut the paired odor's input by 90%. Left: how far each odor's input falls.
Right: MBON11's odor-evoked spikes afterwards. Rings: flies (Hige et al. 2015; no charge was measured with 4-methylcyclohexanol paired).
